rule_or_requirement: The pixel policy must command more gas on safely aligned clear road before faster valid laps can be evaluated.
observable_information: TRAIN-only pixel curve and hazard features, vehicle speed and road-alignment labels, sampled gas action, finish and off-track outcome.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Add a fixed direct gas credit to TRAIN reward only on clear aligned low-speed road; inference still receives pixels only.
expected_success_endpoint: Late TRAIN mean gas increases by at least 0.02 versus the matched high-head-learning-rate control without collapse of valid finishes.
control: policy-head-activation-candidate-r2-20260928, initialized from the same v2 actor with the same seed, steps, optimizer rates and TRAIN split but direct gas reward zero.
falsifier: Late TRAIN mean gas does not rise by 0.02, or valid finishes collapse or off-track retirement rises materially.
smallest_decisive_experiment: One 4096-decision, 4-update TRAIN run with direct gas coefficient fixed at 8.0 compared with the completed matched zero-credit control.
resource_and_risk_gate: Linux Python 3.11 CPU, 3600-second cap, no tune or protected split, no official site action, no reward-coefficient sweep before activation.
